Go 1.24+; Go/Fyne/MVVM. You must follow this Git workflow strictly for each change you make:
`git checkout main && git pull --rebase origin main`; clean tree; `git pull --rebase origin main`; `go mod download`; `git checkout -b <branch-name>`. Never commit directly to `main`.

TDD: write tests before coding; incremental, isolated, table-driven; cover edge/error cases. Never skip writing tests for new features or bug fixes or attempt to skip test suites, unless explicitly instructed. Always ask the user for confirmation before modifying existing tests. Run `go test ./...`; tests must pass. `git add . && git commit -m "<type>(<scope>): <description>"`

Before PR: `git pull --rebase origin main`; `go mod tidy`; `go test ./...`; `gofmt`; `go vet`. Create against `main`; use `create_pull_request`, fallback `gh`. Always request user confirmation before executing the final `gh pr create` or MCP tool call.

Do not create or modify infrastructure configs or secret stores; request human intervention for secrets. Never commit secrets or private keys. Read `.claude/skills/refresh-context/SKILL.md`.
